Correct call - **Actin disruptors** (cytochalasin B, PubChem CID 5311281, BBBC021 annotated MoA Actin disruptors; ChEMBL CHEMBL411729 no curated mechanism).

The profile was textbook actin disruption: strongly reduced cell_area z -8 to -13.7, extreme frac_multinucleate_proxy z +8 to +21 (61-78% multinucleate vs 20% DMSO), nuc_solidity z -18 to -28 with irregular/bilobed nuclei indicating cytokinesis failure, dose-dependent act_glcm_contrast rho +1.0 p=0 and act/tub heterogeneity/intensity (tub_mean z 27-31, act_mean z 16-27, act_std z 14-18).

The 1 µM well was visually ambiguous (composite-only) suggesting Eg5/Microtubule stabilizer rounded mitotic-like cells, correctly down-weighted vs 3 independent high-dose wells with concordant image + profile evidence. Dose responses for frac_multinucleate_proxy, cell_area, tub_mean and act_glcm_contrast all monotonic support actin mechanism, not primary mitotic arrest.

Literature consistent: cytochalasin B caps barbed-ends/shortens actin filaments PMID 2916838, PMID 8204105, and acute cytochalasin B differentially interferes with actin-binding protein function PMID 40914162.

reflection.text:
This was a correct call: unblinded compound cytochalasin B, PubChem CID 5311281 / ChEMBL CHEMBL411729, truth = Actin disruptors, agent = Actin disruptors p=0.86, verdict correct.

What the evidence got right:

The 4-well sample across the dilution series (0.3 uM w_f97f19f984, 1 uM w_9c437e9416, 3 uM w_d7217e9f72, 10 uM w_b9f2cbcfb2, from 8 doses 0.01-30 uM available in e1) captured a coherent, dose-ordered actin disruption syndrome rather than a microtubule-primary phenotype. The most diagnostic signal was actin texture/amount, not tubulin: act_glcm_contrast z=+36.0 at 10 uM (e3) with dose_response rho=+1.00 (p=0) across 4 doses (e14), and act_mean z=+27.6 at 3 uM (e8). This punctate/aggregated actin signal paired with reduced cell_area z=-8.4 at 1 uM and z=-7.2 at 0.3 uM (e2, e9) and cell_nuc_area_ratio z=-5.0 (e9), consistent with loss of F-actin fibers, cell rounding and reduced spreading.

The cytokinesis-failure readout frac_multinucleate_proxy z=+8.4 at 1 uM (e2) with rho=+0.80 (p=0.2) over 4 wells (e11) and the microscopist call in e5 on 4 fields — density lower vs DMSO, candidates Actin disruptors / Aurora kinase inhibitors — provided orthogonal image support for failed cytokinesis. The phenotype at higher doses included extreme tub_mean elevations (z=+7.5 at 1 uM in e2, z=+27.7 at 10 uM in e3, z=+31.3 at 3 uM in e8) and tub_std z=+23.0 (e3) and low nuc_solidity z=-27.9 (e8), but dose_response of tub_mean rho=+0.80 (p=0.2) tracked actin changes rather than forming an independent microtubule-stabilizer pattern. Atlas comparison correctly stabilized on this: NSC vote 2/2 then 3/4 Actin disruptors (e4, e10), which was the basis for the submitted rationale.

Cytochalasin B identity was verified post-submission as name and BBBC021 structure agree with no curated ChEMBL mechanism to bias the call (e17, e18). Literature returned in this run supports the assigned MOA: actin filament capping and cleaving activity of cytochalasins B, D, E and H PMID 2916838 and the more nuanced observation that cytochalasin B may shorten actin filaments by a mechanism independent of barbed end capping PMID 8204105, as well as recent work on differential interference with actin-binding protein function by acute cytochalasin B PMID 40914162 and PMID 39372773. The general barbed-end capping paradigm is exemplified by PMID 7159919. No PubMed hits were returned for the specific query 'actin disruption cytokinesis failure multinucleation cytochalasin' (e20), so the multinucleation interpretation here rests on e2/e11 and e5 alone without literature citation in this run.

What misled or was weak and why:

Two signals could have pulled toward mitotic/microtubule hypotheses. At the lowest imaged dose (0.3 uM, e6) the microscopist on 2 fields called density similar vs DMSO and candidates Eg5 inhibitors / Microtubule stabilizers, which seeded Eg5 inhibitors 0.10 and Microtubule stabilizers 0.05 in the step 7 hypothesis board. The very large tub_mean / tub_std elevations in e3/e8 also superficially mimic microtubule stabilizers. The run correctly down-weighted these because (i) e6 was an early-onset, low-dose field set with 7 observations and similar density, whereas e5 at higher dose and more fields supported actin-related density loss and multinucleation, (ii) the tubulin increase was dose-correlated with act_glcm_contrast and cell_area loss (e12 rho=-0.80 p=0.2, e13 rho=+0.80 p=0.2) rather than isolated, and (iii) NSC vote remained Actin disruptors despite k-neighbour lists showing Protein synthesis 4/10->5/10 and Epithelial 2/10 in e4/e10, indicating neighbors are noisy for this class but the nearest-single-class vote is stable.

Acquisition choices helped: sampling mid (1 uM) and high (10 uM) first (steps 2-3) established dynamic range, then filling 3 uM and 0.3 uM (steps 8-9) enabled dose_response tests. The limitation was statistical power: with 4 wells, rho=+/-0.80 trends had p=0.2 (e11-e13), not significant alone; only act_glcm_contrast reached p=0 with rho=+1.00. The final confidence 0.86 was therefore not driven by any single p-value but by convergence of NSC 3/4, extreme actin texture z=+36, consistent cell_area contraction, multinucleate proxy, and microscopist description. No tool errors occurred, and the review correctly flagged the call as favored and dose-responsive with no more decisive legend data available.

For a real lab follow-up, the proposed orthogonal phalloidin/DNaseI + live SiR-actin with reference actin disruptor comparator and washout cytokinesis rescue would directly test F-actin depolymerization and multinucleation rescue and exclude a primary tubulin mechanism. This is a cell-biology screening interpretation only.

The very large tub_mean / tub_std elevations in e3/e8 also superficially mimic microtubule stabilizers. The run correctly down-weighted these because (i) e6 was an early-onset, low-dose field set with 7 observations and similar density, whereas e5 at higher dose and more fields supported actin-related density loss and multinucleation, (ii) the tubulin increase was dose-correlated with act_glcm_contrast and cell_area loss (e12 rho=-0.80 p=0.2, e13 rho=+0.80 p=0.2) rather than isolated, and (iii) NSC vote remained Actin disruptors despite k-neighbour lists showing Protein synthesis 4/10->5/10 and Epithelial 2/10 in e4/e10, indicating neighbors are noisy for this class but the nearest-single-class vote is stable.

Acquisition choices helped: sampling mid (1 uM) and high (10 uM) first (steps 2-3) established dynamic range, then filling 3 uM and 0.3 uM (steps 8-9) enabled dose_response tests. The limitation was statistical power: with 4 wells, rho=+/-0.80 trends had p=0.2 (e11-e13), not significant alone; only act_glcm_contrast reached p=0 with rho=+1.00. The final confidence 0.86 was therefore not driven by any single p-value but by convergence of NSC 3/4, extreme actin texture z=+36, consistent cell_area contraction, multinucleate proxy, and microscopist description. No tool errors occurred, and the review correctly flagged the call as favored and dose-responsive with no more decisive legend data available.

For a real lab follow-up, the proposed orthogonal phalloidin/DNaseI + live SiR-actin with reference actin disruptor comparator and washout cytokinesis rescue would directly test F-actin depolymerization and multinucleation rescue and exclude a primary tubulin mechanism. This is a cell-biology screening interpretation only.

What was right:
- e2 cell_area z=-8.4 and frac_multinucleate_proxy z=+8.4 at 1 uM matched actin-loss/cytokinesis-failure phenotype
- e3 act_glcm_contrast z=+36.0 and e8 act_mean z=+27.6 plus e14 rho=+1.00 p=0 provided dose-dependent actin texture signal
- e5 microscopist on 4 fields calling Actin disruptors with lower density plus e2/e11 multinucleation trend rho=+0.80 converged with profile data
- e4 and e10 NSC vote 2/2 then 3/4 Actin disruptors correctly prioritized despite noisy k-neighbours Protein synthesis 4/10-5/10
- e17/e18 lookup confirmed cytochalasin B CID 5311281 / CHEMBL411729 name and BBBC021 structure agree, no curated mechanism to confound

What was wrong or missed:
- e6 at 0.3 uM (2 fields) suggested Eg5 inhibitors / Microtubule stabilizers with similar density, seeding Eg5 0.10 and creating contradictory evidence e6 retained through final board
- tub_mean z=+27.7 to +31.3 in e3/e8 and tub_std z=+23.0 and nuc_solidity z=-27.9 mimicked microtubule stabilizer/DNA effects; e10 k-neighbour Epithelial 2/10 also misleading
- dose_response p=0.2 for rho=+/-0.80 in e11-e13 reflects n=4 underpowering, so trends alone were not significant except act_glcm_contrast

Proposed next experiment: As proposed in conclusions: fixed-cell phalloidin/DNaseI + live SiR-actin vs reference Actin disruptor at matched doses plus washout cytokinesis assay with tubulin counterstain.
